name: prereg3:fixed
note: Frozen config from dev search (2018-2021). Cost: Coinbase taker 0.66%/side (alts 0.80%). PASS iff on the test period: Sharpe > fixed allocation at the same average exposure, AND CAGR > that benchmark, AND max drawdown no more than 10 points worse, AND CAGR > 0. PROMOTE to paper trading only if it also passed validation (2022-2023: FAIL). Single-asset families also run on holdout coins LTC/BCH/ETC (2018-2026): PASS iff Sharpe and CAGR beat the exposure-matched fixed allocation on at least 2 of 3. Run once; no tuning afterwards.
